Gates carry no mass: score.py:46 weighted sums only `weights` keys; gate dims appear only as pass/fail (score.py:41 `all(scores[k] > floor ...)`). Gates zero and skip: score.py:48 `reward = round(weighted,4) if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0`; score.py:83 returns 1 on gate failure; test.sh:216-222 `1) exit 0` before `run_suite scored` (test.sh:224), and test.sh:212 `rm -rf $LOG_DIR/scored` prevents a stale scored reward.json; test.sh:60 writes a zero reward first, gates-suite timeout (test.sh:213) exits with that zero, score.py error (exit 2) -> write_zero_reward (test.sh:221,227). A scored-suite timeout leaves the post-gate score.py output where scored_ran=False -> floors_passed=False -> reward 0. Gate dims are binary single-criterion with aggregation='all_pass' (gates/render/judge.toml:14-23, gates/constraints/judge.toml:40-49), so a gate is exactly 0 or 1. EXECUTED (in-memory synthetic RewardKit outputs under scratchpad, `python -I -B task/tests/tools/score.py`): gate render=1,constraints=0 with perfect scored -> exit 1, reward 0.0000; gates ok but no scored -> 0.0000; functional 0.04, polish 1, visual 1 -> 0.0000 (weighted_score 0.424 suppressed, floors_passed 0); functional 0.06 -> 0.4360; all 1 -> 1.0000; missing gate key -> exit 2 (test.sh then writes zero). Floor arithmetic: functional has 44 criteria, total weight 61.0, so the 0.05 floor needs >3.05 weight units. Plausible broken app that passes both gates (sign-in, add a candidate, reload, Observer sees it) but nothing else: likely passes hro_add_candidate (1) and hro_anonymous (1.5, requires 401s with successful controls) = 2.5/61 = 0.041 < 0.05 -> reward 0 even with perfect visual (simulated: 0.0000). Hence passing only the cheap gates earns nothing (Internal row 44 satisfied). In-dimension gates in scored/{functional,polish,visual}/prompt.md (lines 11-13, 11-12, 11-12) give binary 0 / Likert 1 (normalized 0) to blank/static shells, so a non-working app cannot farm polish/visual even before the floor. Conforming-alternative check: gate demands are public (hireops_rules.md:11 password sign-in, :19 Observer reads the board, :33 new card at bottom of Applied; instruction.md:19 accounts), and the gates stay simple load/reload/server-backed as LESSONS #4 advises; strictness lives in scored rows. LESSONS patterns reviewed for this row: #2 (weights untouched; shared 1.0/1.5/2.0 scheme), #4 (gates simple), #11 (judge infra crash zeroes a dimension: gate infra failure yields reward 0 via NOT EXERCISED binary0 - template behaviour, recorded not a task defect).
